About this item

  • ☆【RAM, ROM And Expandable】:- 8GB RAM with 256GB internal storage for smooth multitasking, app usage, photo storage and daily productivity; no expandable card slot support.
  • ☆【Display】:- 6.7-inch P-OLED display with 1220 x 2712 resolution, 120Hz refresh rate, HDR10+ support and up to 4500 nits peak brightness for sharp visuals and smooth viewing.
  • ☆【Camera】:- 50MP main camera with OIS and multi-directional PDAF + 50MP ultrawide camera for detailed shots and wider framing; 50MP front camera supports selfies and high-resolution video calls.
  • ☆【Processor】:- Powered by Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 octa-core processor with Adreno 722 GPU, designed for responsive performance, multitasking, entertainment and everyday smartphone use.
  • ☆【Battery】:- 5000 mAh battery with 68W wired charging and 15W wireless charging support for dependable daily usage and convenient recharging.

Product description

Experience style, speed and flagship-inspired design with the Motorola Edge 70 5G in Bronze Green. Crafted with an ultra-slim profile and premium finish, this smartphone brings together powerful performance, immersive visuals and advanced camera capabilities for everyday productivity and entertainment. The large 6.7-inch P-OLED display delivers sharp 1220 x 2712 resolution, fluid 120Hz refresh rate and vibrant color output for a smooth viewing experience while scrolling, gaming and streaming. With HDR10+ support and peak brightness up to 4500 nits, content appears clear and vivid across different lighting conditions. Powered by the Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 processor and paired with 8GB RAM, Motorola Edge 70 5G is built to handle multitasking, apps, gaming and daily usage with ease. The 256GB internal storage provides ample space for photos, videos, apps and files, while UFS 3.1 support helps deliver faster data access and responsive performance.Capture detailed shots with the advanced 50MP main camera featuring OIS and multi-directional PDAF, alongside a 50MP ultrawide camera for wider scenes and added creative flexibility. On the front, the 50MP selfie camera is designed for sharp selfies and high-resolution video calling. The camera system supports 4K video recording, making it suitable for content creation and everyday memories.The 4800mAh battery is designed to keep up with your day, and 68W wired charging helps you power up quickly when needed. It also supports 15W wireless charging for added convenience. Additional highlights include stereo speakers with Dolby Atmos, in-display fingerprint sensor, NFC, Gorilla Glass 7i protection, IP68/IP69 water and dust resistance, and Smart Connect support.Motorola Edge 70 5G is a strong choice for users looking for a sleek, lightweight smartphone with balanced performance, premium display quality, reliable cameras and fast charging in one modern device.

    About this Item

    • ☆【RAM, ROM And Expandable】:- 8GB RAM with 256GB internal storage for smooth multitasking, app usage, photo storage and daily productivity; no expandable card slot support.
    • ☆【Display】:- 6.7-inch P-OLED display with 1220 x 2712 resolution, 120Hz refresh rate, HDR10+ support and up to 4500 nits peak brightness for sharp visuals and smooth viewing.
    • ☆【Camera】:- 50MP main camera with OIS and multi-directional PDAF + 50MP ultrawide camera for detailed shots and wider framing; 50MP front camera supports selfies and high-resolution video calls.
    • ☆【Processor】:- Powered by Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 octa-core processor with Adreno 722 GPU, designed for responsive performance, multitasking, entertainment and everyday smartphone use.
    • ☆【Battery】:- 5000 mAh battery with 68W wired charging and 15W wireless charging support for dependable daily usage and convenient recharging.

The 256GB internal storage provides ample space for photos, videos, apps and files, while UFS 3.1 support helps deliver faster data access and responsive performance.Capture detailed shots with the advanced 50MP main camera featuring OIS and multi-directional PDAF, alongside a 50MP ultrawide camera for wider scenes and added creative flexibility. On the front, the 50MP selfie camera is designed for sharp selfies and high-resolution video calling. The camera system supports 4K video recording, making it suitable for content creation and everyday memories.The 4800mAh battery is designed to keep up with your day, and 68W wired charging helps you power up quickly when needed. It also supports 15W wireless charging for added convenience. Additional highlights include stereo speakers with Dolby Atmos, in-display fingerprint sensor, NFC, Gorilla Glass 7i protection, IP68/IP69 water and dust resistance, and Smart Connect support.Motorola Edge 70 5G is a strong choice for users looking for a sleek, lightweight smartphone with balanced performance, premium display quality, reliable cameras and fast charging in one modern device.
